acceptedScope: phase-separated v2 source identity, immutable v1 lineage, gate-input closure, and source-only authority boundary
findings: The v2 subject freezes receipt-independent candidate inputs before any receipt and binds the exact v1 predecessor, reviewed index, source transitions, gate inputs, limitations, validator record, and pre-review execution.
Historical v1 live-path and validator identity resolve from immutable Git snapshots, while only v2 resolves the evolved current candidate bytes.
